[6] The minimum and maximum life expectancy are determined by the survival curves (10th and 90th percentiles, respectively).

[7] Liver-specific knockout of frataxin (FXN) caused preliminary deaths of animals (50% died till 30 weeks old) and promoted liver tumor formation. Various biological processes in the liver and hepatocytes of such mice were dysregulated.

[8] The age was counted from hatching. Ferric ammonium citrate (6.6 mg/ml) was added to the culture media.

[9] The age was counted from hatching. Ferric ammonium citrate (6.6 mg/ml) was added to the culture media.

  organism: the model organism studied, one lowercase word
  direction: exactly one of 'increases lifespan', 'decreases lifespan', or 'no change'
  method: how the gene was altered, e.g. gene knockout, overexpression, mutation, knockdown

Output one block per passage, in order, formatted exactly:
[0]
organism: ...
direction: ...
method: ...

Nothing else. If a passage does not state something, write 'unstated'.
